body.title: Host: sending attachments with a message
body.summary: chat-panel.ts. Only the submit-turn caller takes the pending attachments: runTurn gains an explicit attachments argument that the submit-turn case fills, and the grant re-run and the selection continuation pass none (review finding). The submit-turn case supersedes queued approvals when the text is non-blank OR attachments are pending (review finding). The session and its pending list are captured before waiting for in-flight attachment writes; if the active session changed or the panel closed during the wait the submit is dropped and the attachments stay pending on their session; a second submit waits its turn behind the first (review finding). The user row stores the user's text with the attachments and user-row echoes them; the prompt sent to the CLI ends with the attached-files block of absolute paths; readDirs carries the session's attachments directory on this turn and on every later turn of a session whose transcript holds an attachment, including grant re-runs and selection continuations; a first message with blank text names the chat from its first attachment.
acceptanceChecks: A submit stores the text with the attachments on the row, echoes them on user-row, sends a prompt ending with the attached-files block, passes readDirs, clears the pending list and posts an attachments-pending with no items
A submit with blank text and an attachment runs a turn, supersedes queued approvals and names the chat from the attachment; with blank text and none it is a no-op
A grant re-run and a selection continuation leave the pending list untouched and attach nothing, but pass readDirs when the session has an attachment

A submit waits for an attachment still being written and carries every chip in order; a chat switch during the wait drops the submit and keeps the chips on their session; a second submit runs after the first
A session with no attachment passes no readDirs and stores rows exactly as today
